sources.observation: Special-category overflow earns no further reward and is excluded from standard retail rewards. Headline rates and caps match the configured model.
Billing-month aggregate cashback rounds down to whole AED. Current headline tier rates and bucket caps match.
Reward points depend on daily Prime membership, purchase subtype and monthly spend within assigned credit limit. No account-specific membership or credit-limit setting was found in versioned config.
